rules.statement: An administrator's bond given as security for the performance of duties, not payment of a certain sum, is not chargeable under item 15(b) but falls under item 15(i).
rules.supporting_quote: It seems to me clear that this bond is in quite a different class from bonds given as security for the payment of a definite and certain sum of money.

meta.parties: The Hon, the Attorney General v. Mount
